toast(options).description: Shows a toast: { title, description?, variant?, action?: { label, onClick }, duration? }. Returns an id for dismiss(id).
toast(options).html: VinUI.toast({ … }) or data-vin-toast="Title" on a button (with data-vin-toast-description, -variant)

duration.description: Milliseconds before it closes. Hovering or focusing it pauses the timer.

Toaster.description: Put it once in your app; toasts appear in it.

Toast.description: The toast itself, if you want to show one inline.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Press the button. In HTML, add data-vin-toast="Title" to a button, or call VinUI.toast({ title }).

examples.title: Success, error and action
examples.description: Icons for success and errors, and an action such as Undo.

examples.title: How it looks
examples.description: The same toast shown inline, for reference.

a11y: Each toast is a status message (role="status"), so screen readers read it without moving focus. Errors use role="alert".
Toasts sit in a landmark named "Notifications", so keyboard users can find them.
The timer pauses while the pointer or focus is on a toast, and every toast has a close button (WCAG 2.2.1).
Don't put the only way to do something in a toast: it goes away.
